about: M9 review F5/F11 (plan 7.4 rule 11): under M89 a positioning block runs the defined cycle. CC only sets the circle centre (the pole) and moves nothing, so it is no positioning block: its X and Y are data (axisWords: data), like those of BLK FORM.

states.about: The stock form's corners are values, not positions.
Rule 4: M89 runs the cycle in its own block and starts the modal call.
CC X+50 Y+50 sets the pole: no move, so no cycle, and the modal call stays.
A pole at the origin is no position either.
M99 on the last position runs the cycle once and ends the modal call.
